title: 第798章 满意就好第797章 席间回忆
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
文慧怡抿了一口酒后：继续说：“一来一回，不仅自给自足，还有盈余。”
诱至此，她看向沈算，眼中带着几分感激：“说起来，还要多谢世兄。若不是世兄的诡市令，慧怡女子学院怕是早已关门了。”
沈算摆摆手：“举手之劳，不值一提。”
文慧怡摇头：“对世兄是举手之劳，对我却是雪中送炭。”
李雪婷听着，眸光微动。
她看向沈算，似乎想说什么，又忍住了，夹了一筷鱼肉，慢慢嚼着，若有所思。
窗外，夜风拂过，竹影婆娑。
远处的山峦已隐入夜色，只有天边的最后一抹余晖还未散尽。
“表哥。”李雪婷忽然开口。
“嗯？”沈算看向她。
“你的诡市令，能不能……”她顿了顿，有些迟疑，“能不能也给我一枚？”
沈算看着她，没有立刻回答。
李雪婷咬了咬唇：“我不是想占表哥的便宜。我可以付钱，也可以帮表哥做事，只是……我想给自己留一条后路。”
沈算沉默了片刻，从怀里取出一枚诡市令，放在桌上，推到她面前。
“不用付钱，也不用帮我做事。”他说，“你是我表妹，这就够了。”
李雪婷怔怔地看着那枚令牌，手指微微颤抖。
她伸手拿起，握在掌心，低头沉默了好久，才轻声道：“谢谢表哥。”
文慧怡看着这一幕，没有说什么，只是端起茶杯，轻轻抿了一口。
烛火摇曳，将三人的影子投在墙上，忽长忽短。
窗外，夜色渐深。远处传来几声犬吠，又被夜风吹散。

竹影在月光下婆娑，像是有人在低语。
酒过三巡，菜过五味。
文慧怡看了看天色，起身告辞：“世兄，天色不早，我该回了。”
李雪婷也跟着起身：“我也该回了，家父还在等我。”
沈算也不挽留，起身送两女出门。
院门外，钟源早已候着，牵来三匹马。
七彩鹿安静地站在一旁，月光洒在它的身上，鹿角泛着淡淡的荧光。
“世兄，今日多谢款待。”文慧怡翻身上鹿，回头看了沈算一眼。
“满意就好。”沈算笑道。
李雪婷也上了马，握着缰绳，低头看着沈算，“表哥，后日我来玩，你会欢迎嘛？”
“会的。”沈算点头。
李雪婷点了点头，一抖缰绳，策马而去。
文慧怡轻轻拍了拍鹿颈，七彩鹿迈开蹄子，不紧不慢地跟在后面。
月光下，两道身影渐行渐远，最终消失在夜色中。
钟源站在沈算身后，看着那两道远去的背影，挠了挠头：“少爷，您吃饱了嘛？”
“废话，当然没吃饱了。”沈算转身往回走，“杨婶炖的肉还有吗？”
钟源愣了一下，随即笑了：“有，有，肯定有。”
content_en:
After Wen Huiyi took a sip of wine, she continued: "Every time I come back, I will not only be self-sufficient, but also have a surplus."
At this point, she looked at Shen Suan with a bit of gratitude in her eyes: "Speaking of which, I would like to thank Brother Shi. If it weren't for Brother Shi's strange order, Huiyi Women's College would have closed long ago."
Shen Suan waved his hand: "It's a small effort, not worth mentioning."
Wen Huiyi shook her head: "It's a small effort for my brother, but it's a help in times of need for me."
Li Xueting's eyes moved slightly as she listened.
She looked at Shen Suan, as if she wanted to say something, but held back, picked up a chopstick of fish meat, and chewed it slowly, thoughtfully.
Outside the window, the night wind blew and the bamboo shadows danced.
The mountains in the distance have faded into the night, and only the last twilight on the horizon has yet to dissipate.
"Cousin." Li Xueting suddenly spoke.
"Huh?" Shen Suan looked at her.
"Can you give me your special order..." She paused and hesitated, "Can you give me one too?"
Shen Suan looked at her and didn't answer immediately.
Li Xueting bit her lip: "I don't want to take advantage of my cousin. I can pay or help my cousin, but... I want to leave a way out for myself."
Shen Suan was silent for a moment, then took out a secret order from his arms, placed it on the table, and pushed it in front of her.
"You don't have to pay me, and you don't have to do things for me." He said, "You are my cousin, that's enough."
Li Xueting stared at the token blankly, her fingers trembling slightly.
She reached out and picked it up, held it in her palm, lowered her head and was silent for a long time, and then said softly: "Thank you, cousin."
Wen Huiyi looked at this scene and said nothing. She just picked up the teacup and took a sip.
The candlelight flickered, casting the shadows of the three people on the wall, growing and shrinking.
Outside the window, the night is getting darker. A few dog barks were heard in the distance, but were blown away by the night wind.
The bamboo shadows danced in the moonlight, as if someone was whispering.
After three rounds of wine, five flavors of food.
Wen Huiyi looked at the sky, stood up and said goodbye: "Brother, it's getting late, I should go back."
Li Xueting also stood up: "It's time for me to go back, my father is still waiting for me."
Shen Guang didn't want to hold him back, so he got up and sent the two girls out.
Outside the courtyard gate, Zhong Yuan was already waiting with three horses.
The colorful deer stood quietly aside, with the moonlight shining on its body and its antlers glowing with light fluorescence.
"Brother, thank you for your hospitality today." Wen Huiyi rolled over and looked back at Shen Suan.
"As long as you are satisfied." Shen Suan smiled.
Li Xueting also got on the horse, holding the reins and looking down at Shen Suan, "Cousin, will you welcome me when I come to play tomorrow?"
"Yes." Shen Suan nodded.
Li Xueting nodded, shook the reins, and rode off.
Wen Huiyi patted the deer's neck gently, and the colorful deer spread its hooves and followed leisurely.
Under the moonlight, the two figures drifted further and further away, finally disappearing into the night.
Zhong Yuan stood behind Shen Suan, looked at the two retreating figures, and scratched his head: "Master, are you full?"
"Nonsense, of course I'm not full." Shen Suan turned around and walked back, "Do you still have the meat that Aunt Yang stewed?"
Zhong Yuan was stunned for a moment, then smiled: "Yes, yes, there must be."
